title: Flipside
body: The show on their side. The notes on yours.
notes: Hi, I'm Kartik. You're looking at the audience side of my phone. I'm looking at my notes. Same phone.

title: Every pitch happens on a phone now.
body: A realtor with a listing. A founder in a hallway. Turning your phone around shows them your notes, your texts, everything.
notes: Nobody has a tool for the one-on-one pitch. Decks take an afternoon on a laptop.

title: The Duo has a public face and a private face.
body: Stand it up, two faces. Lay it flat, one desk. Fold it shut, done.
notes: Watch the top half. The hinge drives this, not a button.

title: Say a topic. Get a deck.
body: Share a link or a sentence and the slides build while you talk.

title: Point at things.
body: Your finger on your half, a dot on theirs.
notes: The flat half is a trackpad for their screen.

title: Close the phone.
body: The recap is already in their inbox.
notes: Say nothing. Close it. Wait for the buzz.
